title: Prevention of postoperative sternal wound infections using cold plasma therapy
summary: Elective cardiac surgery patients who meet the inclusion criteria will be randomized into either the control group (n = 330, conventional thorax closure) or the study group (n = 330, conventional thorax closure with additional application of cold plasma therapy).

interventions.name: The thoracic  closure is conventionally performed with wire cerclages.
After sternal clousre and before subcutaneous and cutaneous sutering, standardized cold plasma therapy is applied. The thoracic closure is performed conventionally.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients undergoing median sternotomy as part of an elective heart surgery.
No clinical signs of preoperative thoracic inflammation.
Capable patients aged over 18 years.
Signed informed consent.
Exclusion criteria:
Reoperations
Emergency cases
Patients with endocarditis
Existing osteitis at two or more locations
Immunological comorbidities (such as autoimmune diseases)
Women during pregnancy and breastfeeding
Participation in other therapy studies
Inability to give informed consent (e.g., HOPS, dementia, etc.)
Patients who decline participation or wish to withdraw their consent during the study.
